gen-fs-excon-gf-esteban: Approachable and quick, Excon packs its letters in tight with a smooth, unshaded outline, while Esteban adds a faint wedge of pen pressure in every curve. Its serif lowercase looks oversized.
gen-fs-excon-gf-faustina: Faustina brings a text serif with bowls that thin gently and a jaw-like c that stays open. Then Excon's tightly packed, bent-wire sans lines carry the heading, so a long page keeps an authoritative, steady feel.
gen-fs-excon-gf-fragment-mono: Excon crowds its letters together like chalk marks, tall in the lowercase, and its open terminals keep that density friendly. Fragment Mono lines up below like nails on a ruler.
gen-fs-excon-gf-halant: Halant is a text serif with outward-pointing terminals and a towering x-height. If the heading sits beside it, Excon's fixed-nib strokes feel crisp against Halant's faint, never dramatic, thick-thin shifts.
gen-fs-excon-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Crowded letters like chalk marks on a full slate give Excon its punch, with no pinched joints or flared ends. Hedvig Letters Serif follows with sturdy, tall lowercase and a gentle weight change in each bowl.
gen-fs-excon-gf-major-mono-display: Excon is tightly packed and friendly. Major Mono Display, a monospace in tube-like neon strokes with large sidebearings, spreads out below it and gives the headline's density room to breathe.
gen-fs-excon-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC is a text serif with pulled-back terminals and tall lowercase. Excon's bent-straw lines and crowded letters sit above it, making a sharp, tight heading over a dignified, moderate-contrast body.
gen-fs-excon-gf-martian-mono: Structured and technical, Martian Mono spaces its fixed-width monospace letters far apart with generous curve openings, while Excon sits tight above. Excon handles punchy density; Martian Mono handles loose clarity.
gen-fs-excon-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab brings robust downstrokes and slender turns. Excon has no stroke contrast at all and packs tight for impact, while Montagu Slab's sizable x-height and open e carry the reading.
gen-fs-excon-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Tight, chalky and friendly up top, then a refined classic serif below. Excon draws a single-width trail like a rolling-ball pen, and Noto Serif Hentaigana adds moderate contrast with small letters nearly capital height. Their difference in stroke is the pair's draw.
